name: LMEQualificationDTO
description: LMEQualificationDTO schema from Monitor Plan Management OpenAPI Specification

qualificationDataYear.description: Year corresponding to the qualification data.

operatingHours.description: Annual number of operating hours used to determine qualification.

so2Tons.description: Annual SO2 value used to determine qualification.

noxTons.description: Annual NOX emissions to determine qualification.

id.description: Unique identifier of a monitoring qualification LME record.

qualificationId.description: Unique identifier of a monitoring qualification record.

userId.description: User account or source of data that added or updated record.

addDate.description: Date and time in which record was added.

updateDate.description: Date and time in which record was last updated.
